continuity.arc_goal: Design and implement linked services Phase A (object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade, state/invocation rejection on completed objects) while investigating and planning fix for issue #4566 (awakeable signals lost during partition leadership transitions).

progress_update.summary: We conducted deep research into GitHub issue #4566 — awakeable signals lost during partition leadership transitions. Traced the full root cause through the dedup mechanism, identified all 4 vulnerable call sites, designed the concrete fix (migrate to handle_rpc_proposal_command), analyzed performance impact (~2-10ms added latency, acceptable), and designed a multi-level test strategy with a primary failing-then-passing RPC handler test.
progress_update.goal: Design and implement linked services Phase A: object-to-object linking with completion, onCompleted handlers, GC cascade, and state/invocation rejection on completed objects. Side investigation: research and plan fix for issue #4566 (awakeable signal loss during leadership transitions).
accomplished: Researched issue #4566 end-to-end: traced root cause through self_propose_and_respond_asynchronously → Bifrost commit confirmation → epoch-based dedup fencing in apply_record
Identified all 4 vulnerable call sites: append_signal, append_invocation_response, append_invocation (Appended mode), restart_as_new_invocation (legacy path)
Designed concrete fix: migrate to handle_rpc_proposal_command with new Action::ForwardAppendedResponse, phased implementation (signal first, then invocation response, then invoke)
Analyzed performance impact: +2-10ms typical latency (same as /send path), no throughput impact, acceptable for low-volume awakeable path
Designed multi-level test strategy: Level 1 RPC handler test (fails now, passes after fix), Level 2 dedup unit test, Level 3 state machine integration test
progress_update.now: Completed test strategy design for issue #4566. Ready to either begin implementation of the fix or return to linked-services Phase A implementation.
next_steps: Begin implementation of #4566 fix if prioritized: Phase 1 add ForwardAppendedResponse action, Phase 2 migrate append_signal, Phase 3 migrate append_invocation_response
Or resume linked-services Wave 1 implementation: ServiceEdges table, NodeId type, VirtualObjectStatus::Completed
Wave 2: Three vertical command slices (LinkService, CompleteService, UnlinkService)
Wave 3: State machine handlers (link establishment, completion + rejection, unlink + GC cascade)
constraints: All tables are logical (2-byte KeyKind prefix) within one RocksDB CF per partition
NodeId enum with Object variant only for Phase A
Proto type IDs: LinkService=0x0415/0x8015, CompleteService=0x0416/0x8016, UnlinkService=0x0417
NotifySignalRequest and InvocationResponse need Optional request_id field added for fix
WAL serialization must remain backward compatible (Option<T> defaults to None)
ServiceCompletionNotification and InvocationResponse are orthogonal — graph management vs result delivery
Completed objects reject new invocations at inbox AND state mutations from in-flight handlers
Direct cycle detection only (point read) — transitive cycles cause GC leak but not correctness issue
decisions: Strategy A (migrate to handle_rpc_proposal_command) chosen over drain-on-stepdown, separate dedup namespaces, or re-proposal approaches
Single Action::ForwardAppendedResponse rather than per-command action variants — all 3 high-priority sites return Appended
Level 1 RPC handler test as primary failing test — follows existing append_invocation.rs test patterns with MockActuator
Defer restart_as_new_invocation legacy path fix — it's being deprecated as fleet upgrades past protocol V4
Unlink (not RemoveLink) as the verb for edge removal — UnlinkServiceCommand, UnlinkServiceRequest, ctx.unlink()
VirtualObjectStatus: Unlocked | Locked(InvocationId) | Completed(ResponseResult) — mutually exclusive, Completed is terminal
Vertical command slices for linked-services implementation — each command task covers its full stack (journal + proto + codec + outbox + WAL)
EdgeState on LinkedTo: Active { completion_handler_name } | Completed — handler name consumed on completion, drops out
GC cascade: no parents + Completed → delete state/promises/status/edges + propagate UnlinkServiceRequest to children
Phase A ships independently from Phase B (invocation linking) — Phase A anchors only objects, Phase B adds WorkflowInvocation nodes
open_questions: Whether append_invocation Appended→Submitted response type change is a breaking API change for ingress
Whether WAL format version bump is needed for adding Option<PartitionProcessorRpcRequestId> to command payloads
No timeout on partition processor RPCs — pre-existing concern surfaced during analysis
handle.getOutput() for objects — how does a workflow await an object's completion result?
Batch GC optimization — batching UnlinkServiceRequest per destination partition (separate issue)
risks: Adding request_id to NotifySignalRequest changes WAL serialization — needs careful backward compatibility testing
